paraphrase: Given possible occurrence of the none-to-some transition C* and possible-event causability, the source asserts possible causation of that same transition. It excludes a contingent cause because no contingent thing can exist prior to the beginning of all contingent things, and infers a possible noncontingent cause. The conclusion tooltip calls a cause a prior condition that explains or partly explains something else.
